ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 60% high-intensity white pixels on lateral lobes vs 40% low-intensity black pixels in the central region and along the trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity black pigmentation with feathered, dendritic margins extending into high-intensity white lobes. Discrete, small low-intensity spots are scattered across both lobes. A distinct yellowish-tan mid-intensity patch is visible on the upper-inner quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with an approximate angle of 85 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the posterior boundary; characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks and valleys (3-8 pixel depth) isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a consistent concave sweep from the median notch to the distal tips; leading edge appears generally linear.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-contrast heterogeneous clusters (mix of brown, white, and tan pixels) localized at the extreme distal tips of both left and right fluke lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical black linear 'feathering' marks at the interface where the central black pigmentation meets the white lobes; sparse, faint grey linear disruptions on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent organic growth/barnacle clusters at both fluke tips; a circular yellowish-brown stain on the upper surface of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, 'feathered' transition zone between primary black and white pigmentation regions in the fluke center.
